narrative.headMessage: Jalapeño treats compute, memory, and network as one flow
narrative.subMessage: It keeps prefill and decode flexible instead of locking them into separate pools.
narrative.headline: The key is not more parts, but an integrated design that reduces data movement.
narrative.summary: The architecture recognizes different compute and memory bottlenecks while keeping the KV cache and network close to the work.
narrative.story: In simple terms, input processing, token generation, and cache reads are connected as one system flow.
keyTakeaways: Prefill is about compute; decode is about memory bandwidth.
The KV cache stays close, while the workload mix is not fixed in advance.
